title: Many-Body Protection of Topological Edge Memory in Strong Interacting Quenches
summary: Quantum quenches drive edge states far from equilibrium, yet whether the memory of a topological initial state survives in a non-integrable, interacting system has remained largely unexplored. We study this question in the bond-alternating XXZ chain---an interacting Su--Schrieffer--Heeger model hosting symmetry-protected topological edge modes with markedly enhanced boundary magnetization---and analyze quenches across all combinations of single-particle and many-body initial and final Hamiltonians.
